blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla on Friday said he will ask the House prosecution panel in the Senate impeachment court to submit evidence pertaining to the alleged misuse of confidential funds of Vice President Sara Duterte’s worth P612 million. Remulla also said the Office of the Ombudsman is evaluating the evidence and will “file the necessary cases when ready.” The ombudsman made this known as the House prosecution on Tuesday said it dropped three of four impeachment articles against Duterte, including Article I on confidential funds. According to impeachment prosecutors, the remaining Article II, which pertains to the unexplained wealth, […]...
